description:
ERP Analysts Inc . an  Oracle Platinum Partner  specialized in Oracle product licensure, implementations, upgrades and production support for PeopleSoft, Fusion Applications, Fusion Middleware, EPM, Business Intelligence and Identity Management solutions. 
   
 ERP Analysts Inc.  has been in IT business for 16 years, Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio. With  550+ employees and 60+ direct clients , we have a proven track record of providing consulting services and delivering successful projects to mid-market and fortune 500 companies. Our client centric approach to providing services has allowed us to consistently grow every year.
   
 ERP Analysts Inc.  is known for its  Oracle’s PeopleSoft  (Enterprise Resource Planning application) Proficiency and Quality of service. As an Oracle Platinum Partner, we have access to resources offered only to companies that continue to demonstrate the highest level of expertise and experience when designing, implementing and supporting Oracle Products.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
